newsitem.title: USA: Russia needs more reforms, says Summers.
newsitem.headline: Russia needs more reforms, says Summers.

text.p: Russia needs a new generation of economic reforms, U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Wednesday.
Addressing the American Council on Germany on the eve of his trip to Moscow, Summers said: "A second generation of reforms is imperative."
Summers said Russia needed "a tax system that works," and that its government must be able to enforce law and order.
Legal codes were needed to facilitate business operations and transactions, and to attract both foreign capital and the flight capital from Russia's own citizens, Summers added.
Summers said the United States and Germany would continue to stand together in support of Russian economic reform. ((Ellen Freilich 212-859-1679))
